business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

change_fees_usd.description: Sum of the recorded change fees on the changeable itineraries in the request.

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_week.description: Monday of the first open, conflict-free venue week on or after standard ticket confirmation (ISO date).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: basic-fare itineraries that cannot be changed and are forfeited on a move

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the rush queue would save after the venue calendar and attendee conflicts are reapplied.

group_fare_usd.description: Group fare per new ticket on the group desk's confirmation.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for the analytics guild offsite booking changes.
